<!-- Partial: topic and narrative discovery. -->

This section implements both topic-discovery options from the project outline.

- **Option 1**: sentence embeddings + community detection, treating each detected community as a narrative group.
- **Option 2**: BERTopic for interpretable topic-word themes and supporting summaries.

For Option 1, we add lightweight labels using top TF-IDF terms per detected group.

```{python}
#| label: topics-load-prepare
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from utils import Data

data = Data().load("norm")
_posts = data.posts.copy()

text_col = next(
    c
    for c in ["normalized", "post", "content"]
    if c in _posts.columns
)

_posts[text_col] = _posts[text_col].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
_posts = _posts[_posts[text_col].str.len() >= 20].copy()

# Put an upper limit on corpus size to keep the run tractable.
MAX_DOCS = 15_000
if len(_posts) > MAX_DOCS:
    _posts = _posts.sample(n=MAX_DOCS, random_state=42).copy()

_posts = _posts.reset_index(drop=False).rename(columns={"index": "_orig_index"})
_posts["_doc_id"] = np.arange(len(_posts))
print(f"Embedding sample: {len(_posts):,} posts | text_col={text_col!r}")
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-classification-preprocess
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import re
import string

import nltk
from nltk.corpus import stopwords
from nltk.stem import PorterStemmer
from nltk.tokenize import word_tokenize

nltk.download("stopwords", quiet=True)
nltk.download("punkt", quiet=True)
nltk.download('punkt_tab', quiet=True)

_stop = set(stopwords.words("english"))
_stemmer = PorterStemmer()
_punct_or_digits = re.compile(r"^[\d" + re.escape(string.punctuation) + r"]+$")


def preprocess_text(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    toks = word_tokenize(text.lower())
    toks = [t for t in toks if not _punct_or_digits.match(t)]
    toks = [t for t in toks if t not in _stop]
    toks = [_stemmer.stem(t) for t in toks]
    return toks, " ".join(toks)


cls_df = _posts[["submolt", text_col]].copy()
cls_df = cls_df.dropna(subset=["submolt"])
cls_df["submolt"] = cls_df["submolt"].astype(str).str.strip()
cls_df = cls_df[cls_df["submolt"].str.len() > 0]

# Keep reasonably represented labels for stable stratified train/test splits.
MIN_PER_CLASS = 40
MAX_CLASSES = 20
vc = cls_df["submolt"].value_counts()
keep_labels = vc[vc >= MIN_PER_CLASS].head(MAX_CLASSES).index
cls_df = cls_df[cls_df["submolt"].isin(keep_labels)].copy().reset_index(drop=True)

tok_and_txt = cls_df[text_col].fillna("").astype(str).map(preprocess_text)
cls_df["tokens"] = tok_and_txt.map(lambda x: x[0])
cls_df["clean_text"] = tok_and_txt.map(lambda x: x[1])
cls_df = cls_df[cls_df["clean_text"].str.len() > 0].copy().reset_index(drop=True)

print(
    f"Classification corpus: {len(cls_df):,} docs | "
    f"{cls_df['submolt'].nunique()} classes (top submolts, min {MIN_PER_CLASS}/class)"
)
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-classification-bow-tfidf
#| warning: false
#| message: false

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer, TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_score, recall_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB

baseline_rows = []

X_train_txt, X_test_txt, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    cls_df["clean_text"],
    cls_df["submolt"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=cls_df["submolt"],
)

# 1) Naive Bayes with Bag-of-Words
bow = CountVectorizer(max_features=30_000, min_df=3, ngram_range=(1, 2))
Xtr_bow = bow.fit_transform(X_train_txt)
Xte_bow = bow.transform(X_test_txt)
nb_bow = MultinomialNB()
nb_bow.fit(Xtr_bow, y_train)
yp_bow = nb_bow.predict(Xte_bow)
baseline_rows.append(
    {
        "model": "Naive Bayes (BoW)",
        "accuracy": round(accuracy_score(y_test, yp_bow), 4),
        "precision": round(precision_score(y_test, yp_bow, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
        "recall": round(recall_score(y_test, yp_bow, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
        "f1": round(f1_score(y_test, yp_bow, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
    }
)

# 2) Naive Bayes with TF-IDF
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=30_000, min_df=3, ngram_range=(1, 2))
Xtr_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_txt)
Xte_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_test_txt)
nb_tfidf = MultinomialNB()
nb_tfidf.fit(Xtr_tfidf, y_train)
yp_tfidf = nb_tfidf.predict(Xte_tfidf)
baseline_rows.append(
    {
        "model": "Naive Bayes (TF-IDF)",
        "accuracy": round(accuracy_score(y_test, yp_tfidf), 4),
        "precision": round(precision_score(y_test, yp_tfidf, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
        "recall": round(recall_score(y_test, yp_tfidf, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
        "f1": round(f1_score(y_test, yp_tfidf, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
    }
)

baseline_results = pd.DataFrame(baseline_rows)
if not baseline_results.empty:
    print(baseline_results.to_string(index=False))
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-classification-word2vec
#| warning: false
#| message: false

from gensim.models import Word2Vec
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

X_train_tok, X_test_tok, y_train_w2v, y_test_w2v = train_test_split(
    cls_df["tokens"],
    cls_df["submolt"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=cls_df["submolt"],
)

w2v = Word2Vec(
    sentences=X_train_tok.tolist(),
    vector_size=100,
    window=5,
    min_count=2,
    workers=4,
    epochs=10,
    sg=1,
    seed=42,
)

def _doc_vec(tokens: list[str]) -> np.ndarray:
    vecs = [w2v.wv[t] for t in tokens if t in w2v.wv]
    if not vecs:
        return np.zeros(w2v.vector_size, dtype=np.float32)
    return np.mean(vecs, axis=0)

Xtr_w2v = np.vstack([_doc_vec(t) for t in X_train_tok])
Xte_w2v = np.vstack([_doc_vec(t) for t in X_test_tok])

clf_w2v = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1200)
clf_w2v.fit(Xtr_w2v, y_train_w2v)
yp_w2v = clf_w2v.predict(Xte_w2v)

row = {
    "model": "Word2Vec + LogisticRegression",
    "accuracy": round(accuracy_score(y_test_w2v, yp_w2v), 4),
    "precision": round(precision_score(y_test_w2v, yp_w2v, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
    "recall": round(recall_score(y_test_w2v, yp_w2v, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
    "f1": round(f1_score(y_test_w2v, yp_w2v, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
}
if baseline_results.empty:
    baseline_results = pd.DataFrame([row])
else:
    baseline_results = pd.concat([baseline_results, pd.DataFrame([row])], ignore_index=True)

print(baseline_results.to_string(index=False))
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-embed-community
#| warning: false
#| message: false

from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer, util
import os

MODEL_CANDIDATES = [
    "google/embeddinggemma-300m",
    "sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
]

model = None
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
for model_name in MODEL_CANDIDATES:
    try:
        model = SentenceTransformer(model_name, device="cpu")
        print(f"Using embedding model: {model_name} (device=cpu)")
        break
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Model load failed for {model_name}: {exc}")

if model is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not load any sentence embedding model.")

sentences = _posts[text_col].tolist()
embeddings = model.encode(
    sentences,
    batch_size=64,
    show_progress_bar=True,
    convert_to_tensor=True,
    normalize_embeddings=True,
)

MIN_COMMUNITY_SIZE = 30
SIM_THRESHOLD = 0.72
communities = util.community_detection(
    embeddings,
    min_community_size=MIN_COMMUNITY_SIZE,
    threshold=SIM_THRESHOLD,
)

topic_ids = np.full(len(_posts), -1, dtype=int)
for k, members in enumerate(communities):
    topic_ids[np.array(members, dtype=int)] = k

_posts["topic_id"] = topic_ids
covered = int((_posts["topic_id"] >= 0).sum())
print(f"Detected communities: {len(communities)}")
print(f"Clustered posts: {covered:,}/{len(_posts):,} ({covered / len(_posts) * 100:.1f}%)")
print(f"Noise/unassigned posts: {(topic_ids < 0).sum():,}")
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-labels
#| warning: false
#| message: false

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

assigned = _posts[_posts["topic_id"] >= 0].copy()
if assigned.empty:
    raise RuntimeError("No communities assigned; lower threshold or min_community_size.")

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10_000,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.5,
    stop_words="english",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
)
X = vectorizer.fit_transform(assigned[text_col].values)
feat_names = np.array(vectorizer.get_feature_names_out())

topic_rows = []
for tid in sorted(assigned["topic_id"].unique()):
    idx = np.flatnonzero(assigned["topic_id"].values == tid)
    centroid = np.asarray(X[idx].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    top_ix = centroid.argsort()[::-1][:12]
    top_terms = ", ".join(feat_names[top_ix])
    size = int(len(idx))
    topic_rows.append(
        {
            "topic_id": int(tid),
            "n_posts": size,
            "share_pct": round(size / len(_posts) * 100, 2),
            "top_terms": top_terms,
        }
    )

topic_terms = pd.DataFrame(topic_rows).sort_values("n_posts", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
print(topic_terms.head(20).to_string(index=False))
```
